name: MINOS
full_name: Main Injector Neutrino Oscillation Search (including MINOS+)
summary: MINOS compared magnetized detectors at Fermilab and Soudan to measure muon-neutrino disappearance. MINOS+ reused the detectors with the higher-energy NuMI configuration; both phases completed data taking in 2016.
physics_targets: Atmospheric neutrinos and neutrino propagation tests
detection_principle: Alternating magnetized steel and plastic-scintillator planes track muons and sample hadron showers. Muon curvature measures charge and momentum. Comparing near and far energy spectra reduces shared beam and cross-section uncertainties.
